package.description: Lightweight utility to identify and terminate processes haunting your network ports.

en-US.description: Lightweight utility to identify and terminate processes haunting your network ports.
en-US.longDescription: PortGhost reveals which processes are using specific network ports. Built for developers using .NET 10, it allows for instant identification and one-click termination of "zombie" processes causing EADDRINUSE errors.
en-US.name: PortGhost
